card.name: Ending pieces of brand names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a split-up brand or product name, most often the "AG" ending of ZYPITAMAG, in drug label text. It also fires on pieces inside other rare names, such as Hypermagnesemia and Immedica.

modes.label: ZYPITAMAG ending
modes.description: The "AG" piece that completes the brand name ZYPITAM-AG in statin labeling.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of gemfibrozil with ZYPITAM<<AG>>.

modes.label: Other split rare names
modes.description: Middle pieces of rarely seen names or terms that are split into several parts.

card.plain: It marks the final part of an unusual brand name, mainly ZYPITAMAG, once the name has been split into pieces.
